legend: The $$$N$$$ members of Harker Programming Club are trying to form the new top K-Pop girl group, and they want to take promotional photos! However, due to the differences in the heights of the members, Ms. Datar wants to adjust the formation the form the longest increasing subsequence$$$^{\text{∗}}$$$ in heights. To do so, she can swap any number of disjoint pairs of adjacent elements.
Help her find the length of the longest increasing subsequence that can be formed after any number of such operations.

$$$^{\text{∗}}$$$A subsequence of a sequence is any sequence obtainable by deleting zero or more elements without changing the relative order of the remaining elements. A subsequence is increasing if each of its elements is strictly greater than the one immediately before it.
input: Each test contains multiple test cases.
The first line contains the number of test cases $$$t$$$ ($$$1\le t\le10^{4}$$$). The description of each test case follows.
The first line contains the number of members $$$N$$$ ($$$1\le N\le2\cdot 10^{5}$$$).

The second line contains $$$N$$$ integers $$$h_1, h_2, \ldots, h_N$$$ — the heights of the members. It is guaranteed that $$$h_1, h_2, \ldots, h_N$$$ form a permutation of $$$1, 2, \ldots, N$$$ (in particular, $$$1\le h_i\le N$$$, and all $$$h_i$$$ are distinct).
It is guaranteed that the sum of $$$N$$$ over all test cases does not exceed $$$2\cdot 10^{5}$$$.
output: For each test case, output the maximum length of the longest increasing subsequence.
note: In the first test case, one valid choice of swaps is to swap the 2nd and 3rd members, and separately swap the 6th and 7th members. These two swaps involve disjoint adjacent pairs of positions, so both may be performed at the same time. This turns the sequence $$$1, 3, 2, 4, 5, 7, 6$$$ into $$$1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7$$$, which is already entirely increasing, so the answer is $$$7$$$.

In the second test case, no sequence of allowed adjacent swaps can produce an increasing subsequence longer than $$$2$$$. For example, without performing any swaps at all, the last two members already have heights $$$1, 2$$$, which form an increasing subsequence of length $$$2$$$.

legend.ai: $$$N$$$ Harker 编程社团的成员们正试图组建一支新的顶尖 K-Pop 女团，并且她们想拍摄宣传照！然而，由于成员们的身高各不相同，Datar 女士希望通过调整队形，使身高形成最长递增子序列$$$^{\text{∗}}$$$。为此，她可以交换任意数量个互不相交的相邻元素对。
帮助她求出经过任意次这样的操作后能够形成的最长递增子序列的长度。
$$$^{\text{∗}}$$$序列的子序列是指通过删除零个或多个元素，且不改变剩余元素相对顺序后得到的序列。如果子序列中的每个元素都严格大于其前一个元素，则称该子序列为递增子序列。

input.ai: 每个测试包含多个测试用例。
第一行包含测试用例的数量 $$$t$$$($$$1\le t\le10^{4}$$$)。接下来是每个测试用例的描述。
第一行包含成员数量 $$$N$$$($$$1\le N\le2\cdot 10^{5}$$$)。
第二行包含 $$$N$$$ 个整数 $$$h_1, h_2, \ldots, h_N$$$，表示成员们的身高。保证 $$$h_1, h_2, \ldots, h_N$$$ 构成 $$$1, 2, \ldots, N$$$ 的一个排列(特别地，$$$1\le h_i\le N$$$，且所有 $$$h_i$$$ 互不相同)。
保证所有测试用例中的 $$$N$$$ 之和不超过 $$$2\cdot 10^{5}$$$。

output.ai: 对于每个测试用例，输出最长递增子序列的最大长度。

note.ai: 在第一个测试用例中，一种有效的交换选择是交换第 2 位和第 3 位的元素，并分别交换第 6 位和第 7 位的元素。这两次交换涉及互不相交的相邻位置对，因此可以同时进行。这样就能将序列 $$$1, 3, 2, 4, 5, 7, 6$$$ 变为 $$$1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7$$$，此时序列已经完全递增，因此答案为 $$$7$$$。
在第二个测试用例中，通过任意一系列允许的相邻交换，都无法产生长度超过 $$$2$$$ 的递增子序列。例如，在完全不进行交换的情况下，最后两名成员的身高已经是 $$$1, 2$$$，它们构成了一个长度为 $$$2$$$ 的递增子序列。
